headline: Where the research is going, and why
diagnosis: The search was rebuilt around one rule: a result that cannot be reproduced under a different seed is not a result. Under that rule every headline this system had produced turned out to be mostly selection luck, and the size of the illusion was then measured exactly. Choosing the best of ten risk configurations on the same eight years that score them inflates a result by about eight hundredths. Choosing the best of seventy-two trading bands inflates it by another eight hundredths. Together that is roughly sixteen hundredths of pure optimism per reported number - which matches, almost exactly, the gap repeatedly observed between a champion's headline and what its own configuration reproduces when retrained. The gap was never model quality. It was two nested maximisations.
why_the_returns_are_small: CORRECTED 2026-08-28, and the correction matters more than what it replaces. The strategy earns little for a much simpler reason than any explanation offered before: it invests almost nothing. Averaged over each year, the capital actually at risk has been between half a percent and fourteen percent, and under three percent in every year since 2022 - eight tenths of one percent in the sealed forward window. Measured on the money it actually risks, the strategy returned roughly five hundred percent last year, and between three hundred and one thousand percent in most others. Meanwhile the largest peak-to-trough fall has been under ten percent in recent years, against a limit of twenty-five. So this is not a weak strategy: it is a strong one holding a position so small that the account barely notices. Two things caused it. The rule used to pick a winner rewards the worst year and counts profit for only a tenth as much, and the surest way to protect a worst year is not to trade at all. And every single configuration the search has been allowed to compare holds the same tiny position size, so a larger book has never been measured against a smaller one - it was not rejected, it was never on the menu. Widening that menu is now the first priority, and the result will be presented as a trade-off between return and risk rather than as a recommendation, because where to sit on that trade-off is the operator's decision and not a technical fact.
the_flat_years_question_is_now_closed: One idea has been tested to destruction and the answer is worth stating plainly: the strategy cannot be made to earn in falling and sideways markets by loosening its trend filter. Three separate approaches were tried. Holding a reduced position through downturns turned out to be mechanically impossible, because the filter refuses those trades outright rather than merely shrinking them. Harvesting profit from choppiness by periodically rebalancing was measured on this system's own history and loses money in exactly the two years it was meant to help, because our assets move together too closely for that mechanism to work. And relaxing the filter itself - allowing small positions in falling names - loses steadily more the more it is relaxed, in every year tested. Notably it hurt 2025, a year the market rose, MORE than it hurt the 2022 crash, which says the filter is carrying genuine information rather than simply marking bad years. One result from that experiment reframes everything that follows: the loosened version actually put MORE capital to work and still did worse. So putting more money at risk is not automatically better - what matters is HOW it is added. Adding it by taking weaker trades loses. Whether adding it by taking the SAME carefully filtered trades in larger size wins is the question now being measured, and its answer will be presented as a trade-off between return and risk for the operator to choose from, not as a recommendation.
superseded_diagnosis: The most useful thing learned so far is why the yearly profit is modest, and it is structural rather than a matter of tuning. The strategy's yearly record is dominated by a single extraordinary year; setting that year aside, the four most recent years average about six percent each, which is almost exactly what the sealed forward window produced. The strategy is judged on its WORST year, and its worst years are the falling and sideways ones - in which its entire defence is to stop trading, holding almost nothing. That defence works: it does not lose much. But a strategy that survives bad years by standing aside cannot earn in them either, so its worst year is pinned near zero by design. This is why a long series of refinements - position sizing, a risk breaker, regime gates, a lead-lag signal, a second opinion from a different kind of model - has moved the result so little. Every one of them adjusts trades the system chooses to take, and none can produce a return in a year when the book is deliberately empty. Earning in falling and sideways markets is therefore a change of design, not a setting, and that is now the main line of work.
direction: Removing the second one produced the largest improvement in this system's history, and not by adding anything. The trading band had been chosen by maximising validation return per symbol, while the strategy is actually judged on its worst calendar year across a concentrated portfolio - two different objectives. Optimising the first hard was steering away from the second: in a controlled test on identical seeds, sweeping the band cost about a tenth of the score, and the band the sweep preferred earned four times the validation return while performing worse where it counted. Hard optimisation of the wrong measure is worse than no optimisation at all. With the band fixed per candidate instead of maximised, results also became roughly twenty times more repeatable - which finally explains why averaging several networks had made things worse rather than better, since it had pushed variance into that same selector. The reproducible level has now crossed from about minus ten hundredths to zero: the worst calendar year one can actually expect to reproduce is near break-even rather than a double-digit loss.
workstreams: Learned money management, now settled: a model trained on every past trade opportunity and its counterfactual outcome decides position size, replacing hand-written rules. Tested properly - the same network scored twice, with and without it, so luck cancels - it is worth a real but modest improvement, and it behaves as a dial that charges a steady price in drawdown for every unit of extra return. At full strength it breached the 25% loss limit in one year, so it ships at half strength, which keeps a comfortable buffer. A higher setting scored better still and was refused, because configurations that survive only by running to the edge of that limit have already been measured here to travel badly.

Honest triggering: a candidate is now compared against the incumbent only after its score is corrected for the selection advantage it enjoyed, so expensive verification is spent on genuine improvements rather than on lucky maxima.

Seed-verified promotion, standing guard: any candidate clearing the bar is retrained under fresh seeds and promoted only if the median clears it too - the machinery that caught the lucky champion and has since refused two more.

An honest caveat on the headline: the strategy on file is profitable in every year from 2018 to 2025, and that is true of the model actually shipped - the one that would have been traded. It is not, however, a dependable property of the method. Retraining the same recipe under four different random starts produced a losing year in two of them. The every-year record should be read as something this model did, not as something the approach guarantees.

Every remaining idea in the toolbox has now been tested the honest way, one network scored with and without each: a learned position-sizing model is the only one that helps, and only modestly. A second opinion from decision trees actively hurt, because opinions are averaged and a hesitant voice drags a confident one below the threshold to act. A circuit breaker that trades return for safety did not combine with sizing as expected, because two effects of opposite sign are not therefore opposite in timing.

So the next move is new INFORMATION rather than more tuning: news and sentiment with clean point-in-time timestamps, admitted only if they are also readable live at deployment. Everything on file is derived from price, and that well now looks close to dry.

adopted_configuration.adopted: 2026-08-29, at the operator's order ('Adopta'), after the balance criterion selected it on research years only
adopted_configuration.name: package v2: balanced trend book + tilted capitulation sleeve
adopted_configuration.trend_book: champion band + risk with regime_deploy 0.50, max_drawdown 0.50 (abort), money_model 0.5
adopted_configuration.sleeve: 30% of equity, monthly rebalance, worst-bar cash cap (system007_capitulation_dip.combine); capitulation rule enter 0.50, drop_sizing 0.5

adopted_configuration.pending_mechanics: best.json risk flip + promotion-bar re-derivation deferred until the running paired experiment (P17) finishes, so its within-experiment pairing is not corrupted

rules: The forward window is SEALED: never a selection or optimization input, only ever observed (a single readout at adoption, recorded in sealed_readouts.jsonl).

Long-only, research-only. Drawdown is an objective to MINIMISE and always REPORT - the old hard 25% abort was removed by the operator (2026-08-28); the adopted trend book carries a 50% abort as its outer rail.
Every idea carries a kill criterion, and refuted ideas are recorded with their honest result rather than deleted.
A result that cannot be reproduced under a different seed is not a result.
Before optimising any proxy, confirm it measures what the final score measures.
Test a change by scoring the SAME network with and without it, so luck cancels instead of being argued about.
The operator's return target is a minimum of +30% per calendar year; the gap to it is closed by ADDING complementary streams, never by loosening proven filters (P13).
Lever rankings are NET-DEPENDENT and compositions are LOCAL: every combination is measured in situ on the artifact that ships, never assumed from parts.
